description: This file defines a benchmark class 'PingBenchmark' designed to measure grain-to-grain communication latency and throughput in an Orleans-based distributed system. It sets up multiple silo hosts, optionally creates a client, and provides various benchmarking methods for ping operations and load generation.

classes.name: PingBenchmark
classes.description: A class that sets up Orleans silos and clients, performs ping benchmarks, load generation, and cleanup for measuring Orleans grain communication performance.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Benchmark method that invokes a ping operation on the grain.

methods.name: PingForever
methods.description: Asynchronously performs continuous ping operations in a loop.

methods.name: PingConcurrentForever
methods.description: Runs concurrent ping operations indefinitely with high concurrency.

methods.name: PingConcurrent
methods.description: Runs a limited number of concurrent ping operations.

methods.name: PingConcurrentHostedClient
methods.description: Runs concurrent pings using a hosted client obtained from the hosts list.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Helper method to generate load by repeatedly calling grain methods with concurrency.

methods.name: PingPongForever
methods.description: Continuously performs interleaved ping-pong messages with another grain.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Stops all hosts and the client, performing cleanup asynchronously.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Performs cleanup and disposal of resources; marked with GlobalCleanup for test cleanup.

methods.name: CancelPressed
methods.description: Handles console cancel key press event to exit the application.
